title: ‘The Uprising’ Star Woody Norman on the ‘Power Trip’ Playing King Richard II and Going Meatless at Age 10 After Working With Joaquin Phoenix
content:
ByMarc Malkin

Senior Editor, Culture and Events

Filming “The Uprising” gave British actorWoody Norman, who plays 14-year-old King Richard II in the historical fiction drama, a massive headache.

It turns out the only crown they had for him to use during the shoot got damaged the first day of filming. “So it didn’t fit my head,” Norman, 17, tells me over Zoom from a hotel room in Los Angeles just a few hours before the movie’s premiere at the DGA in West Hollywood. “I would leave every day with a splitting headache because it was bent. We had put foam in it, but it didn’t work. It was steel against my head.”

“The Uprising,” written and directed by Paul Greengrass, is based on the real-life Peasants’ Revolt of 1381 England.Andrew Garfieldtoplines the film as a fictional farmer — known only as Ploughman — who sparks and helps lead thousands of commoners on a march to protest the king in London.

In addition to the dented crown, Norman had to endure the royal wardrobe, including “really heavy” robes. “I don’t weigh much,” he tells me later on the red carpet at the premiere. “I weigh 46 kilograms [about 101 pounds] and they weigh as much as I do, so it was really really painful.”

Even so, it’s fun to be king. “It’s a power trip,” Norman says. “All of the supporting actors would go, ‘Your highness,’ and they would bow to me when I walked by. That really got to my head because they would do it every day.”

Norman’s first day shooting with Garfield was a pivotal fight scene between Ploughman and the king. “I was very intimidated,” Norman says. “It’s Andrew Garfield, you know that’s big. He immediately went, ‘I love you, and come on, come on!’ I was like, ‘OK, we’re both actors. We can do this.’ It completely removed that sense of awe and made us both professionals. We’re here to do a job. Let’s do it together. I’m very, very grateful for that.”

The scene involved Ploughman shoving a paper scroll into the king’s mouth. “I have an Invisalign wire in my teeth,” Norman says. “The paper was in my teeth until after we wrapped. It was cool to rub my tongue on my teeth and go, ‘Oh, the uprising.’”

Norman first gained attention when he was just 10 years old and starred opposite Joaquin Phoenix in the 2021 Mike Mills drama “C’mon C’mon.” “One of the great men on the planet is Joaquin,” Norman says. “I don’t know if I would still be acting if I didn’t work with him.”

He continues, “I didn’t really understand what I was. I didn’t know I was an actor. I didn’t know this was a job. I was having fun, and then he made me realize that it doesn’t have to be a job. It’s a way of living. It’s a way of creating, and you know, now after working with Joaquin, I’m fully vegan because of course I am.”

Norman laughs.

“There was an interaction we had where I was eating meat and he was like, ‘Why don’t you just stop eating meat?’” he remembers. “And then I said, ‘Why don’t you stop smoking?’ He’s still smoking, so he hasn’t kept up his bit.”

Up next?Variety’s Leo Barraclough exclusively reported thatNorman will star in the British urban horror thriller “Skag & Bone”along with Malachi Kirby, Tuppence Middleton, Conrad Khan and Kola Bokinni.

“The Uprising” is in theaters now.
title_zh: 《起義(The Uprising)》的明星伍迪·諾曼(Woody Norman)談到飾演理查二世(King Richard II)的「權力之旅」，以及在與華金·菲尼克斯(Joaquin Phoenix)合作後，10歲時選擇不吃肉的經歷。
content_zh:
由馬克·馬爾金(Marc Malkin)報導

資深編輯，文化與活動

拍攝《起義(The Uprising)》讓英國演員伍迪·諾曼(Woody Norman)感到非常頭痛，他在這部歷史虛構劇中飾演14歲的理查二世(King Richard II)。

結果發現，拍攝期間他唯一可以使用的王冠在拍攝的第一天就損壞了。“所以它不適合我的頭，”17歲的諾曼在洛杉磯的一間酒店房間裡通過Zoom告訴我，就在電影在西好萊塢的DGA首映前幾小時。“我每天都會因為它變形而頭痛欲裂。我們在裡面放了泡沫，但沒有用。那是鋼鐵對著我的頭。”

《起義(The Uprising)》由保羅·格林格拉斯(Paul Greengrass)編劇和導演，基於1381年英國的真實農民起義。安德魯·加菲爾德(Andrew Garfield)在電影中擔任主角，飾演一位名叫農夫(Ploughman)的虛構農民，他引發並幫助帶領數千名平民前往倫敦抗議國王。

除了受損的王冠，諾曼還必須忍受皇家服裝，包括“非常沉重”的長袍。“我體重不重，”他在首映的紅毯上告訴我。“我體重46公斤（約101磅），而這些長袍的重量和我一樣，所以真的非常痛苦。”

儘管如此，當國王還是很有趣的。“這是一種權力的享受，”諾曼說。“所有的配角都會說，‘殿下，’當我經過時他們會向我鞠躬。這真的讓我感到驕傲，因為他們每天都這樣做。”

諾曼與加菲爾德的第一天拍攝是一場關鍵的打鬥場景，農夫與國王之間的對抗。“我感到非常害怕，”諾曼說。“那是安德魯·加菲爾德，你知道這有多重要。他立刻說，‘我愛你，來吧，來吧！’我當時想，‘好吧，我們都是演員。我們可以做到。’這完全消除了那種敬畏感，讓我們都變得專業。我們在這裡是為了工作。讓我們一起完成它。我非常非常感激。”

這場戲涉及農夫將一卷紙捲塞進國王的嘴裡。“我牙齒裡有一根隱形牙套的線，”諾曼說。“那張紙一直在我牙齒裡，直到拍攝結束。能用舌頭摩擦牙齒，然後說，‘哦，起義。’這感覺很酷。”

諾曼在10歲時首次引起關注，與華金·菲尼克斯(Joaquin Phoenix)共同主演2021年邁克·米爾斯(Mike Mills)的劇情片《來吧，來吧(C’mon C’mon)》。諾曼說：“華金是地球上偉大的人之一。我不知道如果沒有和他合作，我是否還會繼續演戲。”

他接著說：“我當時並不真正理解我自己是什麼。我不知道我是一名演員。我不知道這是一份工作。我只是覺得很好玩，然後他讓我意識到這不一定要是一份工作。這是一種生活方式。這是一種創造的方式，你知道，現在在與華金合作後，我完全是素食主義者，因為我當然是。”

諾曼笑了。

“我們有一次互動，我在吃肉，他問我，‘為什麼不停止吃肉呢？’”他回憶道。“然後我說，‘那你為什麼不停止抽煙呢？’他還在抽煙，所以他並沒有遵守他的承諾。”

接下來的消息？《綜藝》(Variety) 的李奧·巴拉克勞(Leo Barraclough)獨家報導，諾曼(Norman)將與馬拉基·柯比(Malachi Kirby)、塔彭斯·米德爾頓(Tuppence Middleton)、康拉德·卡漢(Conrad Khan)和科拉·博基尼(Kola Bokinni)共同主演英國都市恐怖驚悚片《骸骨與骨頭》(Skag & Bone)。

《起義》(The Uprising) 現已在影院上映。
